instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: QT interval
items.definition: The QT interval is a measure of the time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave in the heart's electrical cycle

items.label: hip geometry
items.definition: Measurements of the hip.

items.label: factor XI measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of Factor XI, typically in blood. Factor Xi is a serine protease involved in the process of coagulation.

items.label: intraocular pressure measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of intraocular pressure. Increased intraocular pressure is a heritable risk factor for primary open angle glaucoma.

items.label: sex hormone-binding globulin measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of sex hormone binding globulin. In men the test is used in when investigating testosterone deficiency.  The SHBG glycoprotein binds to circulating estradiol and testosterone, low levels of SHBG may be implicated in breast cancer etiology.

items.label: age at menarche
items.definition: The age of onset of (human) menarche, the beginning of the first menstrual cycle in an individual

items.label: age at menopause
items.definition: The age of onset of (human) menopause, the beginning of the first menstrual cycle in an individual

items.label: metabolite measurement
items.definition: This is an annotation class for metabolite measurements where the exact metabolite measurements are unknown. Do not annotate to this class.

items.label: vitamin measurement
items.definition: The quantification of some vitamin, typically from a body fluid such as blood. A vitamin is an organic compound required by an organism as a vital nutrient in limited amounts. items.label: hormone measurement
items.definition: The determination of the amount of hormone present in a sample.

items.label: eye measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of some eye structure or property of an eye structure, such as corneal thickness.

items.label: lipoprotein measurement
items.definition: Is the quantification of some lipoprotein

items.label: tocopherol measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of some tocopherol, typically in blood. Some tocopherols have Vitamin E function (note that  tocotrienols also have vitamin E function).

items.label: circulating cell free DNA measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of circulating cell free DNA measured in blood used as an indicator of cell death and as an indicator of disease, for example some tumour types release this.

items.label: facial morphology
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the region of the body that includes the front part of the head from the chin to the top of the forehead, where the mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are located.

items.label: lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A(2) measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of Lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A(2). It is involved in the process of arthrosclerosis and is a cardiovascular disease biomarker.

items.label: protein measurement
items.definition: This is a general class for any measurement of a protein. Do not annotate to this class, request a more specific child term.

items.definition: interleukin 10 levels

items.label: uric acid measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of uric acid, typically in blood. Uric acid is associated with gout, insulin resistance and cardivascular disease.

items.label: visceral:subcutaneous adipose tissue ratio
items.definition: Is a quantification of visceral to subcutaneous adipose tissue.

items.label: follicle stimulating hormone measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of follicle stimulating hormone. ollicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) is a hormone found in humans and other animals. items.label: ovarian reserve
items.definition: Ovarian reserve is a term that is used to determine the capacity of the ovary to provide oocytes that are capable of fertilization resulting in a healthy and successful pregnancy. Ovarian reserve is correlated with levels of FSH and anti-Mullerian hormones.

items.label: visual cortical surface area measurement
items.definition: quantification of the surface area of the visual cortex. The visual cortex is located in the occipital lobe at the back of the brain. It is variable and heritable, and is correlated with visual acuity and visual perception.

items.label: self rated health
items.definition: The process of questioning an individual, usually by means of a survey to determine general health.

items.label: self reported educational attainment
items.definition: A measure of educational progress reported using a questionnaire based approach, often used as a proxy for cognitive performance as the two are correlated.

items.label: copy number variation
items.definition: A quantification of a genomic variation that increases or decreases the copy number of a given region.

items.label: frontal theta oscillation measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of frontal theta event related oscillations, determined by target processing in an oddball paradigm.

items.label: family size
items.definition: Is a quantification of family size, also used as a measure of male fertility.

items.label: male fertility
items.definition: A fertility quality of inhering in a male by virtue of the bearer's disposition to initiate, sustain, or support reproduction.

items.label: birth rate
items.definition: Is a quantification of birth rate, te ratio of live births in an area to the population of that area, expressed per 1000 people in the population per year. Also used as a measure of male fertility

items.label: short sleep
items.definition: Is a quantification of sleep time in humans where average sleep time was less than five hours.

items.label: L lactate dehydrogenase measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of L lactate dehydrodgenase, typically measured in serum, used as a marker of tissue breakdown as LDH is abundant in red blood cells and can function as a marker for hemolysis

items.definition: Is a quantification of Fructose-Bisphosphate Aldolase,is an enzyme catalyzing a reversible reaction that splits the aldol, fructose 1,6-bisphosphate, into the triose phosphates dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP) and glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (GAP).

items.label: interleukin-6 measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of interleukin-6, a  pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory cytokine.

items.label: interleukin-8 measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of interleukin-8, is a chemokine produced by macrophages and other cell types such as epithelial cells. items.definition: Is a quantification of interleukin-1 beta, an IL-1 cytokine family protein, secreted by macrophages and a mediator of inflammatory response.

items.label: resistin measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of resistin, a cytokine secreted by immune and epithelial cells in human and associated with obseity and type II diabetes by some studies

items.label: sex ratio
items.definition: The number of males per 100 females, usually counted for live births but sometimes applied at a later life stage

items.label: temperament and character inventory
items.definition:
An inventory for personality traits devised by Cloninger et al. Traits scored include:
Novelty Seeking (NS)
Harm Avoidance (HA)
Reward Dependence (RD)
Persistence (PS)
Self-Directedness (SD)
Cooperativeness (CO)
Self-Transcendence (ST)

items.label: economic and social preference
items.definition: Human economic and social preferences determined by application of a survey or questionnaire.

items.label: genetic variation
items.definition: The genetic variation of individuals in a population.

items.label: neutrophil count
items.definition: The number of granulocytes (polymorphonuclear leukocytes) in a specified volume of blood, usually 1 cubic millimeter.

items.label: calcium measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of calcium, typically in serum. Calcium (Ca2+) plays a pivotal role in the physiology and biochemistry of organisms and the cell. items.label: CD4:CD8 lymphocyte ratio
items.definition: Is the ratio of CD4 vs. CD8 lymphocytes, abormal ratios may reflect an infection such as HIV and the measurement may be used as an indicator of disease progression.

items.label: cortical thickness
items.definition: Is a quantification of the thickness of brain cortex, e.g. measured by MRI, used in the diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease and other neurological conditions

items.label: eosinophil count
items.definition: The number of granulocytes (polymorphonuclear leukocytes) in a specified volume of blood, usually 1 cubic millimeter.

items.label: vitamin B measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of any or all of the B vitamins

items.label: magnesium measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of magnesium in serum.

items.label: age at onset
items.definition: The age at which some process, or disease started in a human individual.

items.label: phosphorus measurement
items.definition: Is the quantification of serum phosphorus used in the diagnosis of hyper or hypophosphatemia, and used in the diagnosis of disease.

items.label: recombination rate
items.definition: Is the genome wide recombination rate.

items.label: renal sinus adipose tissue measurement
items.definition: Is the quantification of adipose tissue located in the renal sinus(es), correlated with chronic kidney disease and obesity.

items.label: autoantibody measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of an autoantibody, an antibody produced by the immune system and directed against an individual's own protein.  e.g. anti-islet autoantibodies.

items.label: volumetric brain MRI
items.definition: Is a quantification of brain volume using magnetic resonance imaging.

items.label: YKL40 measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of the secreted glycoprotein YKL-40  (Chitinase-3-like protein 1) YKL-40 has been associated with asthma, inflammatory disease and cancer progression.

items.label: inflammatory biomarker measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of any molecule involved in the process of inflammatory response.

items.label: urinary arsenic measurement
items.definition: Is the quantification of arsenic urine.

items.label: intracranial volume measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of intracranial volume.

items.label: maximal oxygen uptake measurement
items.definition: Is the quantification of is the maximum capacity of an individual's body to transport and use oxygen during incremental exercise, and is used as an indicator of physical fitness

items.label: testosterone measurement
items.definition:
is a quantification of testosterone, typically in serum. Testosterone is a steroid hormone.Testosterone measurement is used in the diagnosis of
precocious or delayed puberty, infertility (in men and women), ovarian tumours, adrenal tumours and pituitary disorders.

items.label: dihydrotestosterone measurement
items.definition: is a quantification of dihydrotestosterone (DHT), typically in serum. Dihydrotestosterone is a steroid hormone, a small percentage of testosterone is reduced to DHT which has a greater affinity for  androgen receptors.

items.label: facial neural processing
items.definition: Is a quantification of the ability of humans to process different facial expressions, measured by MRI.

items.label: high throughput sequence alignment protocol
items.definition: Is a protocol which provides instructions on the alignment of sequencing reads to reference genome

items.label: age at diagnosis
items.definition: The age, measured from some defined time point e.g. birth at which a subject (e.g. a human patient) is diagnosed with some disease e.g. breast cancer.

items.label: tumor stage
items.definition: Tumor stage as classified by the TNM system. T describes the size of the tumor and whether it has invaded nearby tissue, N describes regional lymph nodes that are involved, M describes distant metastasis (spread of cancer from one body part to another).

items.label: N stage
items.definition: regional lymph node stage

items.label: T stage
items.definition: primary tumor staging

items.label: clinical temporal measurement
items.definition: A temporal measurement related to disease progression

items.label: date of birth
items.definition: The point in time at which an individual was born.

items.label: alive at endpoint
items.definition: A clinical temporal measurement indicating that the subject is alive at the end of the clinical investigation.

items.label: disease recurrence
items.definition: The recurrence of a disease after treatment

items.label: date of diagnosis
items.definition: The point at which a clinical diagnosis is made.

items.label: melanoma staging
items.definition: Staging information for melanoma.

items.label: Breslow thickness
items.definition: The measurement in millimeters of the vertical thickness of primary cutaneous melanoma. Breslow thickness is measured from the granular layer of the epidermis, or the ulcer base (if ulcerated), to the deepest tumor cells. It is used in staging of melanoma. (NCI)

items.label: Clark level
items.definition: A morphologic finding indicating the cutaneous melanoma depth of invasion into the dermis and subcutaneous tissue. OR A system for describing how deep melanoma has spread into the skin. Levels I-V describe the layers of skin involved.NCI-GLOSS

items.definition: a genetic transformation that involves the insertion of a protein coding cDNA sequence at a particular locus in an organism's chromosome. items.definition: The total sum of the genetic information of an organism's somatic cells

items.definition: The total sum of the genetic information of an organism's germline

items.label: comprehensive strength index
items.definition: Compressive strength index (CSI) is a predictive measure for hip fracture risk that integrates multiple parameters including hip BMD, femur neck area, and weight.

items.label: appendicular lean mass
items.definition: Appendicular lean mass is a measurement of skeletal strength of lower limbs and is used as a predictive measure of hip fracture.

items.label: peridontal microbiome
items.definition: The peridontal microbiome is a  collection of collectivity of microorganisms isolated from human gum.

items.label: microbiome
items.definition: A collection or collectivity of microorganisms.

items.label: lean body mass
items.definition: The weight of all organs and tissue in an individual less the weight of the individual's body fat.

items.label: carbohydrate measurement
items.definition: The quantification of some carbohydrate, typically obtained from an individual with the intention of using the measurement in some diagnostic process.

items.label: N-glycan measurement
items.definition: The quantification of N-glycans in a plasma sample.

items.label: leptin measurement
items.definition: Quantification of leptin, a hormone made by adipocytes with a role in the regulation of energy balance.

items.definition: The quantification of some phenylalanine, typically obtained from an individual with the intention of using the measurement in some diagnostic process. For example in the diagnosis of phenylkenonuria (PKU)
